description: Submission-safe month-level calendar normalization table. This file contains only time-string to ISO-month mappings and no participant, gold-answer, or per-sentence provenance.
calendar_rules: ISO 8601 astronomical year numbering is used: 0000 = 1 BCE, -0001 = 2 BCE.
Month-level values are represented as YYYY-MM; Step11 expands them internally to YYYY-MM-01.
Year-only regnal expressions default to the regnal year start month according to the experiment calendar rules.
Season expressions map to representative months: spring=03, summer=06, autumn=09, winter=12.
